scenes.text: You might think you are just an ordinary human, but you actually possess an incredible sensory superpower that easily embarrasses a hungry great white shark.
You have definitely smelled that crisp, earthy aroma right before a massive rainstorm, which is caused by tiny soil bacteria releasing a unique compound called geosmin.
While sharks are famous for detecting a single drop of blood at one part per million, your nose detects geosmin at just five parts per trillion, making you two hundred thousand times more sensitive.

Our ancient ancestors relied heavily on finding fresh water to survive, which is why we evolved this mind-blowing biological radar; drop a comment if you can smell the rain, and hit follow for more amazing facts!
